definition.question: How close are Russia and NATO to direct armed conflict via incidents and force posture?
definition.low_end: Routine peacetime posture with no airspace violations, dangerous intercepts or collisions, and functioning deconfliction hotlines.
definition.high_end: Sustained direct combat between Russian and NATO forces with casualties and ongoing exchange of fire across air, land or sea.

readings.rationale: No graded claims provided to assess. Unassessed - research needed on airspace/sea incidents, intercepts, exercises and eastern flank deployments. Would be higher with verified violations, unsafe intercepts, or mobilization; lower with evidence of routine deconfliction and stable posture.

First assessed reading; prior unassessed. Moves well above routine peacetime posture due to 19-23 Russian Gerbera decoy drones violating Polish airspace for 7h15m on 9-10 Sep 2025, intercepted and shot down (3-4) by Polish F-16s/Dutch F-35s with AWACS/Patriot support, triggering Poland's Article 4 request and NAC solidarity statement 10 Sep 2025.
